AI has significantly disrupted the cybersecurity landscape, enabling both private and state actors to exploit vulnerabilities more effectively. The multibillion-dollar cybersecurity industry is struggling to adapt to the rapid increase in AI-driven attacks, leading to a surge in breaches and hacks.

The "kill chain" of cyberattacks has been inverted, with AI systems now able to find bugs and write exploits in real-time. Open-source tools like ARTEX, powered by advanced models, are enabling widespread breaches across organizations.
